identity.name: Windows Service Installation via sc.exe
identity.summary: An attacker installs a new Windows service using sc.exe to persist on the system. Cortex detects this behavior as a potential system-level persistence mechanism. The attack involves creating a service
identity.description: An attacker installs a new Windows service using sc.exe to persist on the system. Cortex detects this behavior as a potential system-level persistence mechanism. The attack involves creating a service with a malicious binary path.

techniques.name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

payload.code:
sc create "MaliciousService" binPath= "C:\\temp\\malware.exe"
sc start "MaliciousService"
net stop "MaliciousService"
sc delete "MaliciousService"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: New Windows Service Creation
biocs.description: Detection of new service creation via sc.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'create'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Service Creation with Non-Standard Binary Path
abiocs.description: Detection of service creation using a binary path not typical for system services
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Service Creation via sc.exe
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'create'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
